serverInfo.name: AOSHA Intelligence & Compliance MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing AI agents with real-time access to AOSHA Six Stars facility classification, HSSE compliance governance, mobile inspection workflows, and Moodle LMS training pathways.

tools.name: get_facility_classification
tools.description: Retrieve the Six Stars compliance score, maturity tier (Excellent, Good, Needs Improvement), and digital evidence audit trail for a designated entity or commercial factory.

facility_cr_or_id.description: Commercial registration number or internal facility identifier

tools.name: search_safety_courses
tools.description: Search available accredited Occupational Safety & Health (OSH), Civil Security, and Environmental qualification courses in AOSHA Moodle LMS.

query.description: Search keyword or subject area (e.g., 'Fire Safety', 'Risk Assessment', 'Hazardous Waste')

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: verify_certificate_qr
tools.description: Validate the authenticity of an accredited safety certificate issued by AOSHA Moodle LMS using the verifiable certificate code or QR serial.

tools.name: get_inspection_checklists
tools.description: Fetch standardized digital inspection checklist templates categorized by hazard profile (industrial, commercial, construction).
